verdict.rationale: Company and Person are built-in objects that can be related to each other; imports reference related records by company domain or person email. Connected Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 emails and calendar events automatically attach to the matching Company and People records, which gives the core of linked records with activity on each. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented per-record activity timeline view (notes, tasks, field-change history), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
